verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a tax authority's online services need a sign-in path. However, the pack only shows that a sign-in or account-setup page exists (hmrc-docs-18) and never describes the authentication method. Nothing shows whether sign-in uses remote credential MFA rather than biometric liveness, an in-person check, or a PIN sent by post. The one mention of a posted HMRC letter (hmrc-docs-15) concerns employer registration, not sign-in, so it neither supports nor contradicts the story.
